#summary Channel objects.

= Channels =
 * [Channel] objects send and receive [Message]s.
 * [Channel]s use [Endpoints] to encode and decode the [Message]s they send and receive.
 * AmFast has built-in [Channel]s for use with [http://cherrypy.org CherryPy], [http://twistedmatrix.com Twisted Web] and WSGI.
